Buttermilk Marinade for Leaner Meats (chicken breast, leg of rabbit/lamb/mutton, beef sirloin)

The sourness of the buttermilk creates a fresh aroma in the meat. The combination with salt, honey and mustard enhances the natural flavor of the meat and improves the juiciness.

Per 2-3 pounds lean meat:

16 ounces low fat l buttermilk

3 tsps coarse salt

1 tsp honey and/or 2-3 teaspoons lemon juice

3 tbsps chopped fresh herbs (eg lemon thyme, thyme, wild garlic, oregano, parsley, chives) OR 3 tsps dried

1 tbsp wholegrain mustard and 2-3 crushed cloves of garlic

Pour the buttermilk into a sealable container which is big enough for both the meat and marinade. Stir in the salt, honey, lemon, herbs and mustard. Soak the meat in the mixture and leave to marinate for 12 to 48 hours in the fridge turning over the meat over occasionally.

One hour before it’s time to cook take the meat out of the fridge to bring to room temperature. Cook as you normally would (grilling/roasting/frying/braising).

We're doing a roast leg of lamb for New Year's Day but I've used this various times for venison and braised chops.
